summary: Hello, you might remember me for asking which cars can accept the biggest V16 a year or so ago. Now, I’ve found the only coupe bodies in the vanilla game that can accept these big engines are the 2005 Coupes, specifically the ones labeled ‘grm_mercy_26’ and bigger, the smallest one that can accept the biggest V16 being the 2.63m long trim in FR.
